observation.visible_scene: A hiker wearing a cap, jacket and a large backpack stands on a dark rocky ledge at the right edge of a river canyon, head tilted down toward their hands. A wide, muddy river flows through the canyon toward a distant waterfall whose spray forms a white mist plume. A low columnar rock cliff lines the left bank. The sky is filled with thick white and grey clouds. An out-of-focus grass stem and pale leafy bushes occupy the immediate foreground.
visible_changes: The hiker's posture shifts subtly across the clip: the head goes from a clearly bowed position to a slightly more upright one (the cap brim rotates from pointing down-left to pointing more horizontally forward), and the arms/hands move a little relative to the torso.
The blurred foreground stem sways left and right between frames, indicating wind.
The river surface shows continuous turbulent flow with changing ripples, and the waterfall mist plume drifts and reshapes.
The cloud cover drifts and reorganizes slightly over the duration.

The camera stays essentially fixed on the scene (the cliff edge, hiker and horizon hold their frame positions), with only minor handheld wobble; the observed motion is mostly object motion, not camera translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the hiker is holding or looking at, and what they do before the first frame or after the last.
The cause and direction of the wind moving the foreground plant.
Whether the hiker's slight head raise is the start of an action (e.g., looking up at the view) or just a small ongoing adjustment.
uncertain_details: The exact object in the hiker's hands is not resolvable.
Cloud movement is slow and could partly reflect lighting changes rather than true drift.
The degree of head raise is small and may be partly a pose fluctuation rather than a deliberate motion.
